interface.name: caminito_toplevel_identifier_manager_v1

description.summary: ask for the identifier of a window

interface.description:
libxfce4windowing gives a client a window's zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 and nothing that names the window to ext-foreign-toplevel-list or to image capture. This manager answers a wlr handle with the identifier that ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.identifier gives the same window, so the client can find the window's ext handle in a list it binds itself.
This is a private protocol of Caminito's. A client that finds no global falls back to what it did without it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Objects it made are not affected.

request.name: get_identifier

description.summary: ask for the identifier of a window

request.description: Makes an object that answers with one event: the identifier of the window the handle is for, or that the window is gone. The answer comes at once, and the object stays until the client destroys it.

interface.name: caminito_toplevel_identifier_v1
interface.description: Sends exactly one of its events, right after it is made.

event.name: identifier
event.description: The identifier the ext-foreign-toplevel-list gives the window, which is the same for as long as the window exists.

event.name: gone
event.description: The handle's window is closed, or the compositor does not list it. There is no identifier.
